senses.gloss: (Y. מַתְלָא) m. (cmp. h. משל) something tangible (= דבר שיש בו ממש); plausible reason for correcting or retracting an evidence.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 22a:10">Keth. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אם נתנה א׳ וכ׳</he> if she offers a reasonable explanation of her contradictory statements, her second one is accepted.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:9">Gitt. IX, 9</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יהא שם א׳</he> provided no reasonable explanation is offered to show how the report may have arisen by mistake; a. fr. V. <cite ref="M03074"><he>מַתְלָא</he></cite>.
